meta.title: Pricing | MyJudicial
meta.description: Transparent pricing for legal services. Compare fixed fees, book consultations, and pay securely via escrow.

hero.title: Transparent Pricing, No Surprises
hero.subtitle: Clear upfront fees for legal services. You only pay what you agree to before the consultation begins.

fixedFees.title: Fixed Fees Set by Lawyers
fixedFees.text: Every lawyer sets their own hourly or consultation rate. You can easily compare prices before booking.

platformFee.title: Small Platform Fee
platformFee.text: We charge a minimal transaction fee on bookings to maintain the platform and secure escrow system.

escrow.title: Secure Escrow Protection
escrow.text: Your payment is held safely in escrow. The lawyer only gets paid after your consultation is complete.

escrow.title: Protected by MyJudicial Escrow
escrow.text: When you book a consultation, your MTN MoMo or Airtel Money payment is transferred to a secure escrow account managed by MyJudicial. The funds are only released to the lawyer after the consultation has taken place. If the lawyer cancels or fails to show up, you receive a full refund automatically.

cta.title: Ready to get started?
cta.subtitle: Join thousands of Rwandans who have found the right legal help on MyJudicial.
